# Anne Shirley & Stacy

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) — teacher and true, helpful friend · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. > [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and talks with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their walk to school about growing up, writing compositions, and her melodramatic story. Inspired, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forms a story club with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Ruby, and Jane, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scoffs at when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes their efforts.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P22](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0022)_

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

> After finishing school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the official results showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the triumphant news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before ending her evening with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>
